title: Out-of-Range and Invalid Numerical Values
description: Validation of numerical features against domain-specific physical, physiological, and mathematical boundaries.
conditions: Continuous or discrete numeric features with known plausible ranges (e.g., age 0-125, percentage 0-100)
Negative values present in strictly non-negative quantities (e.g., revenue, blood pressure, duration)
Floating point infinity or NaN values occurring after computational pipelines
recommended_methods: Hard boundary validation masks (val < min_allowed or val > max_allowed)
Constraint violation logging with severity levels (Fatal vs Warning)
Physiological boundary assertions from domain reference manifests
selection_rules: If numerical value violates physical reality (e.g. Age = -5 or 350), set to NaN or quarantine record
If value exceeds 99.9th percentile but is physically possible, flag as valid extreme outlier, not invalid
If percentage feature is scaled 0.0-1.0 while others are 0-100, standardize representation
limitations: Requires authoritative domain metadata for bounds definition
Static thresholds fail to detect context-dependent impossibilities (e.g., infant weight = 80kg)
